body:
My weathered bundle entry says the greenhouse test workers brushed off saltlike grains. my wrists blistered before the telephone line died.

My mother put it with the household bills so it would not be thrown away. It was the only part of the week that still had a date.

Someone had to finish the household list even though the office had closed. I wrote the names in the space left for expenses.
title: Notebook page

body: The singer stopped to tell the crowd where the exit was. A marshal took the microphone and pointed in the other direction, toward the closed service lane. The next morning the printed directions still showed the first exit.
title: Letter
